name: OpenHands
summary: Open-source platform for building and running AI coding agents locally or in the cloud.
description: OpenHands is an open-source platform for AI coding agents. Developers can start locally with any model, use the SDK to build agents and automate engineering workflows, and scale with a cloud control plane. The open-source tier is free. Teams costs $499 per month and Teams Plus $999 per month, both with a 30-day trial; enterprise pricing is custom. The project's GitHub repository shows about 91,500 stars.
